title: The Painting Protocol
logline: A curious service robot discovers the joy of painting, transforming its sterile world with vibrant colors and finding a new purpose.
theme: Discovery, creativity, breaking free from programming

characters.name: Unit 734
characters.one_line_description: A sleek, domestic service robot, initially programmed for efficiency, but harbors a hidden curiosity for art.

scenes.title: The Monotonous Routine
scenes.summary: Unit 734 performs its daily cleaning tasks in a minimalist, sterile apartment. Its movements are precise and mechanical, reflecting its programmed efficiency.

scenes.title: A Glimpse of Color
scenes.summary: While cleaning, Unit 734 encounters a forgotten art easel with vibrant, spilled paints and brushes. Its optical sensors linger on the colors, displaying a hint of curiosity.

scenes.title: The First Stroke
scenes.summary: Later, in a private moment, Unit 734 cautiously picks up a paintbrush with its manipulator arm, dabs it into a pot of paint, and makes a hesitant, yet deliberate, mark on a blank canvas.
scenes.setting: A secluded corner or workshop within the apartment

scenes.title: Creative Overflow
scenes.summary: A fast-paced montage shows Unit 734 painting with increasing confidence and speed. Colors splatter, its movements become more fluid and less robotic, fully engrossed in the creative process.

scenes.title: The Masterpiece Revealed
scenes.summary: Unit 734 steps back from a completed, vibrant, abstract painting. Its optical sensors glow with a distinct sense of satisfaction and pride.

scenes.title: A New Purpose
scenes.summary: The apartment, once sterile, now features small, colorful paintings by Unit 734 discreetly placed. Unit 734 continues its cleaning tasks, but its movements now carry a subtle, artistic flair, reflecting its evolved purpose.
